text.text_excerpt: I went to an event here tonight. Its always been one of my favorite hotel bars so of course I enjoyed. The staff friendly as always. Bartender talked to me the whole night and telling me all the great things about the cocktails and how he made them, even made the drinks extra pretty and styled it for me to take pictures for a blog I wanted to write lol. Can't get better than that. They make amazing Chambord Vodka cocktails. You definitely need to give them a try. The appetizers flowing through out the room was yummy, mini muffalettas and shish kabobs that definitely kept me just the right amount of full until I left the party. The music was actually great. Everytime I go to something here...

My favorite place to drink, expensive (14 dollar Martinis), but hard to stop so bring your credit card! Plus the W hotel lounge has great food if you get hungry, but its not open late, so jump on it! The staff is okay for the most part, but in my experience I've been ignored a lot and it takes awhile to get my drinks, even when they aren't super slammed. Also it's one of the few nice bars that you can still smoke in if that's your thing. The pear martini or Bellini is always my faves!

Came here on Saturday night meeting up with some friends to celebrate a birthday. It was unfortunate that I came after my engagement and w/ my fiance we were both TIRED. WB is spacious with its high ceilings but a bit cramped with couches, petite tables w/ candles and a long communal table like w/ equal chairs. As in the namesake, the lights in this joint are BluE. This bar is where the hip and money unconscious come to drink, be loud and obnoxious, and haphazardly pick up chicks. (HA we saw a lame fumble...).
